description: Perturbation condition introducing small structural changes to test reasoning stability.

problems.prompt: Solve: 3x + 5 = 20, then explain what changes if 5 is replaced with a variable k.
Solve: 2(x - 4) = 10, then consider the case where the right-hand side is unknown.
Solve: 5x - 7 = 3x + 9, then explain what happens if both sides contain the same variable.
